src: EC Daily Spend Ledger (Head Chef daily report) via data/ec_budget_snapshot.json, the AM Control Centre Budget Burn source
cap_basis: Interim monthly caps = 23% × Mar–May avg MA revenue (until official caps are issued). M19, M20, M21 and MN have no Mar–May trading history and were capless until 25 Aug 2026; their caps = the weekly budget in force × 52/12 — see cap_basis_by_code. Reprice all four when official caps are issued.
wk_basis: HC weekly base (Total Spend From Sunday + Budget Left This Week)

closure.why: Maki 21 (Birmingham) closed after a fire. Last trading day in the mirror 10/10/2026. Dated, NOT a VENUE_IGNORE entry: every day from 21/08/2026 to 10/10/2026 still counts 20 live sites. Set until to the day BEFORE it trades again; if it trades while this is open the reopen tripwire includes it and shouts. Reopened Fri 30/10/2026 (until set 03/11/2026).

note: ledger = spend GBP by day as the Head Chef filed it (null = not filed that day). wk = weekly food budget keyed by the HC week Sunday (Sun to Sat). cap = interim monthly cap, calendar month. Same figures as the AM Control Centre Budget Burn tab.
